description: This file defines a 'Popover' component in React, which renders a tooltip/popover UI element with configurable placement, arrow, and trigger behavior. It also includes an internal 'ArrowIcon' component and manages DOM portal creation for rendering the popover outside of the main React component tree.

classes.name: ArrowIcon
classes.description: A React component rendering an SVG arrow icon, which adapts its color based on the background color of a sibling element.

methods.name: Popover
methods.description: Main React functional component implementing the popover logic with positioning, trigger handling, portal rendering, and styling based on props and internal state.
